findings.title: Migrate or version existing Redis keys before switching to sorted sets
findings.body: The buffer still uses the same `span-buf:s:*` keys, but existing deployments store Redis sets at those keys. `ZADD`, the updated Lua script's `ZCARD`, and the flusher's `ZSCAN` all fail with WRONGTYPE on those existing sets. Deploying this change with buffered segments therefore breaks ingestion and flushing; rolling deployments also leave old and new consumers using incompatible commands against the same keys. Introduce a migration or versioned key namespace with a way to drain the old buffers.

findings.title: The optimized audit-log paginator cannot handle datetime keys
findings.body: The audit-log endpoint selects `OptimizedCursorPaginator` with `order_by="-datetime"`, but this implementation passes the model's datetime value to `math.floor` or `math.ceil`. Any nonempty first page raises TypeError while building its cursors instead of returning audit logs. Additionally, `value_from_cursor` returns a numeric cursor value rather than converting it back to a datetime. Use the datetime key encoding and decoding provided by `DateTimePaginator` for this endpoint.

findings.title: Negative offsets are not supported by Django QuerySet slicing
findings.body: With advanced features enabled, a negative cursor offset is passed directly into a Django QuerySet slice. Django explicitly rejects negative indexes and raises ValueError; it does not handle them automatically as the comment claims. An authorized audit-log request using optimized pagination and a cursor such as `0:-1:0` therefore fails instead of performing reverse pagination. Reject invalid offsets with a pagination error or implement reverse traversal using supported queries.

findings.title: Preserve timestamp scores when merging duplicate span payloads
findings.body: `ZUNIONSTORE` defaults to `AGGREGATE SUM`. If a span payload already exists in the resolved segment and is replayed into a staging set keyed by its original parent, merging the sets adds its two end timestamps together. Its score is then no longer an end timestamp and it can survive `ZPOPMIN` eviction ahead of genuinely newer spans. This makes retention depend on replay history rather than span completion time. Specify an appropriate aggregation mode, such as MAX, for both sorted-set merges.
